author: Unity
description:
Create Unity projects directly from your terminal, no Hub required. 

Check your installed Editor versions, browse available templates, and set up a new project with a single command. Add the Pipeline package to open your Editor to external tools and start automating.

🔗 Install the Unity CLI + Pipeline package: https://on.unity.com/UnityCLI_Docs
title: Unity CLI: Create and set up projects from the terminal
